description: This file defines a Spring service class 'LoanChargeRefundCommandHandler' that handles loan charge refund commands. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, processes refund commands via the injected 'LoanChargeWritePlatformService', and handles data integrity exceptions. It is annotated with Spring's @Service and @Transactional annotations and designated as a command handler for 'LOAN' entity with 'CHARGEREFUND' action.

classes.name: LoanChargeRefundCommandHandler
classes.description: Spring service class handling loan charge refund commands, executing refund logic, and managing data integrity exceptions.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a loan charge refund command, invokes the service to perform the refund, and handles data integrity errors.
